_note: Benchmarks enter portable through the file provider, because it is the one place the PORT-GIPS-G01 question gets asked. `return_type` is REQUIRED and has no default: a price-only series understates its benchmark by roughly the dividend yield every year, and portable refuses one rather than assuming.

SPX_PRICE_ONLY._note: Included deliberately so the refusal path has something real to refuse. portable will not use this as a benchmark.
